same_open_queue_fixture.program:
//@version=4
strategy("Queue priority", pyramiding=10, initial_capital=10000, commission_value=.03)
if bar_index == 0
    strategy.entry("A", strategy.long, qty=1)
if bar_index == 1
    strategy.entry("B", strategy.long, qty=1)
strategy.exit("Bracket A", "A", profit=10, loss=10)

notes.data: 744 confirmed chart hours per symbol. Official 1m and 15m parents match all OHLC values. All previous daily levels equal confirmed daily closes. The source has no saved backtest window.
notes.model: Closed-hour signals match the same compilation without broker calls. Each next-open sibling uses half of marked equity with the source fee and whole 0.001 base-unit lots. Each relative bracket uses its own entry and is moved to a legal tick while preserving its directional protection. The exit removes inventory in FIFO order.
notes.control: Both within-minute high/low orders produce identical realized results and position sizes. The observed priority fixture places new same-open market orders before an existing bracket. The stop-first sensitivity quantifies the alternative. No funding or added slippage.
